sources.title: TierPoint: Little Rock Data Center page (version modified 3 September 2026)
sources.summary: TierPoint's Little Rock page describes 'the state-of-the-art TierPoint Little Rock data center and colocation facility', which 'is part of a network of TierPoint data centers', and gives its facility as 'Little Rock (LIT) 15707 Chenal Parkway, Little Rock, AR 72211'. Its specifications list 30,000+ total square feet with 9,000+ square feet of raised floor, cabinets and cages available, A-side and B-side power distribution, two 2.25 MW redundant generators with at least 48 hours of runtime, a carrier-neutral facility with diverse fiber, 24x7x365 on-site security, 24x7 remote-hands support and managed, private-cloud, disaster-recovery, security and colocation services, audited annually under SOC 1/SOC 2 and other frameworks. These present-tense statements describe a facility in service.

sources.title: TierPoint news: TierPoint to Build Second Tulsa Data Center (30 May 2017)
sources.summary: TierPoint announced plans for a new Tulsa-area data center, partnering with Compass Datacenters, with an initial phase of about 30,000 sq ft of total space and 16,000 sq ft of raised floor. The release states that TierPoint already operates a 37,000 sq ft data center in Tulsa's historic Brady district with 10,000 sq ft of raised floor, and an Oklahoma City facility of nearly 70,000 sq ft.
sources.date_semantics: Release dated 30 May 2017 (dateModified 2022-08-05). Historical identity context only: it links the Brady district facility's size to the Archer parcel and introduces the Compass-partnered second Tulsa facility; it is not a current status observation. A named company officer quoted in it is not restated.

sources.title: TierPoint news: TierPoint Completes Construction of New Tulsa Data Center (26 February 2018)
sources.summary: TierPoint announced that it had completed construction of its new data center in Tulsa: the initial phase of the $20 million facility includes about 16,000 sq ft of raised floor space with infrastructure support and office space, and 'TierPoint partnered with Compass Data Centers on the project'. The release adds that TierPoint also operates a data center in Tulsa's historic Brady District and two data centers in Oklahoma City.
